title: Moloney Securities Asset Management LLC Lowers Holdings in Apple (AAPL)

text:
Moloney Securities Asset Management LLC lessened its position in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 10.6% in the 4th quarter, according to its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 32,335 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 3,833 shares during the period. Apple comprises 2.3% of Moloney Securities Asset Management LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 3rd biggest holding. Moloney Securities Asset Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $5,472,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
A number of other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also recently bought and sold shares of the business. Several analysts have recently weighed in on AAPL shares. UBS set a $190.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, January 5th. Sanford C. Bernstein restated a “neutral” rating and set a $170.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Thursday. Morgan Stanley restated a “buy” rating and set a $205.00 price objective (up previously from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, January 23rd. HSBC set a $204.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday, January 30th. Finally, Vetr upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $184.49 price target for the company in a research report on Monday, March 5th. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the firm earned $3.36 EPS. analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.3 earnings per share for the current year.
